selection_policy.primary_metric: pooled native-unit MAE on common eligible rows
selection_policy.alpha_selection: 2024 validation only; minimum MAE, then smaller alpha
selection_policy.method_selection: 2024 validation only; minimum MAE, ties naive then seasonal then Ridge
selection_policy.test_policy: Freeze alpha, method and gates before test. Expand fits using labels known at each origin.
selection_policy.cohort: Dynamic origin-only eligibility; at least configured min_training_pairs known supported training pairs. No future survival gate.
selection_policy.scoring: All compared methods use the same rows. Next actual must satisfy the declared target support rule.
selection_policy.fallback: Current supported level and >=min_fallback_quarters valid quarters; no stale-level carry forward. Never used in fair-cohort metrics.

fallback_evaluation.scope: Input/history-driven fallback policy, evaluated separately from the primary common-row cohort
fallback_evaluation.eligibility: Primary support gate fails; current target supported; at least min_fallback_quarters supported historical quarters
fallback_evaluation.selection: Eligibility uses origin history only; next-quarter support is checked afterwards for scoring. No final-deployment segment list or validation winner selects the cohort.
fallback_evaluation.runtime_failure_fallbacks: Not evaluated here; numerical model failures are outside this support-policy experiment
limitations: Historical, sample-limited evidence; no guarantee for an individual segment or the operational quarter.
Validation and test cohorts vary by origin and differ from the final operational fallback list.
Revised source snapshot rather than historical vintages; completeness remains unverified.
Origin and segment observations are dependent; price scores exclude unsupported next-quarter prices.

warnings: Only supplied records; completeness is not established. Three observed months is a support rule, not proof of full coverage.
Missing rows are unknown, never inferred zero. Unobserved property/subtype cells may remain within observed segment months.
Price is a count-weighted geometric mean of positive monthly medians, not a pooled quarterly median or mix-adjusted index.
Price weight coverage is a support proxy, not transaction-level valid-price coverage.
Unit/Villa can include commercial units. No procedure filter is available.
Pseudo-real-time backtests use today's revised snapshot, not historical release vintages.
Inverse log predictions are not automatically unbiased arithmetic means. No prediction intervals are estimated.

Fallback history/input policy is evaluated separately; historical sample-limited errors do not guarantee accuracy for every segment or future quarter. Numerical model-failure fallbacks are not evaluated.
Fractional sales_count values are continuous numerical forecasts of activity, not literal fractional transactions; CSV precision is retained.
2026Q4 is a Q3-based projection generated during Q4, excluding October observations.
Recorded sales activity is not buyer enquiries, agent demand, profit or a guarantee.
